entries.c663916cf088e29e: Under its 5th Medium-Term Management Plan (from the fiscal year ended March 2025 to the fiscal year ended March 2027), the company's basic policy, with ‘Transformation and Challenge’ as its keyword, is to optimize its core business portfolio over the medium to long term and further raise business profit. In its core Steel Structure Manufacturing Business, it sets out an order strategy focused on the Chubu region and sales expansion into other regions; in bridge maintenance, a focus on large-scale expressway renewal and deck slab replacement work; and in steel frames and steel structures, work on super high-rise projects in the Greater Tokyo Area. It states that the Real Estate Leasing Business will secure a certain scale as a stable source of income, and that the Materials Sales Business will pursue new customers and increased sales to existing customers. It also indicates that, as it enters the final year, it has revised the plan's numerical targets in light of the business environment.
